name: SinglePageCreate
title: Templates/Platform/Shell/SinglePageCreate
summary: The page a first-level resource is created on in one screen: its own creation header with no sidebar, a centred form column opening with a small page heading, then stacked sections, each a heading with a Hint over a flush Card of field rows, and a fixed bar under the scrolling form, the same bar Version Detail uses, carrying an optional leading slot plus Cancel and the submit Button. The same page covers a resource with a General section and a collapsed Advanced section, and an action whose submit label follows what it does (Save, Purge, Create). A long create such as Create Service groups `Item` rows under small headings and ends in a full-bleed sticky footer. Fields flag required or invalid only after the submit Button is pressed, and each error clears as soon as its field is edited. Built from `GlobalHeader`, `IconButton`, `Breadcrumb`, `Avatar`, `Hint`, `Card`, `Item`, `Input`, `HelperText`, `Switch`, `FieldRadioBlock`, `Textarea`, `Alert`, `MultiSelect`, `NumberInput` and `Button`.

variants.name: CreatePurge
variants.summary: Create Purge: a Target section of wide rows choosing the Layer and the Purge Type with FieldRadioBlock, an Arguments section whose code-font Textarea follows the chosen type, a warning Alert, and a bar with only Cancel and Purge. Choosing Tiered Cache leaves Cache Key as the only allowed type.

variants.name: CreateService
variants.summary: A long create, Create Service, in five groups of Item rows (General, Delivery Settings, Origins, Cache Expiration Policies and Debug Rules) over a full-bleed sticky footer with Cancel and Save: Name and Address empty, HTTP port 80 preselected, HTTPS ports disabled until a protocol with HTTPS is chosen, and the host header prefilled with ${host}.

variants.name: RequiredFields
variants.summary: Create Service after Save on the empty form: Name and Address carry the required state with This field is required. under them, and typing into either clears its own error.
